SELECT r.id, r.reporter_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(reporter.nickname, ''), NULLIF(reporter.name, ''), reporter.cas_id) AS reporter_name, r.target_type, r.target_id, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN media.title END AS target_title, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(media.thumbnail_key, ''), media.object_key) END AS target_thumbnail_key, r.reason_code, reason.name AS reason_name, r.description, r.status, r.processed_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(processor.nickname, ''), NULLIF(processor.name, ''), processor.cas_id) AS processor_name, r.processed_at, r.created_at, r.version FROM report r INNER JOIN `user` reporter ON reporter.id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN report_reason_type reason ON reason.code = r.reason_code LEFT JOIN `user` processor ON processor.id = r.processed_by LEFT JOIN media ON r.target_type = 'MEDIA' AND media.id = r.target_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT r.id, r.reporter_id, reporter.cas_id AS reporter_cas_id, reporter.name AS reporter_name, reporter.nickname AS reporter_nickname, reporter.avatar_key AS reporter_avatar_key, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report reporter_report WHERE reporter_report.reporter_id = r.reporter_id ) AS reporter_report_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report confirmed_report WHERE confirmed_report.reporter_id = r.reporter_id AND confirmed_report.status = 2 ) AS reporter_confirmed_count, r.target_type, r.target_id, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' AND media.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS target_exists, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN media.title END AS target_title, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN media.description END AS target_description, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN media.uploader_id END AS target_uploader_id, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN media.status END AS target_status, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'MEDIA' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(media.thumbnail_key, ''), media.object_key) END AS target_thumbnail_key, r.reason_code, reason.name AS reason_name, reason.description AS reason_description, r.description, r.status, r.decision_reason, r.processed_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(processor.nickname, ''), NULLIF(processor.name, ''), processor.cas_id) AS processor_name, r.processed_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report related_report WHERE related_report.target_type = r.target_type AND related_report.target_id = r.target_id AND related_report.status IN (0, 1) AND related_report.id != r.id ) AS related_active_report_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.version FROM report r INNER JOIN `user` reporter ON reporter.id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN report_reason_type reason ON reason.code = r.reason_code LEFT JOIN `user` processor ON processor.id = r.processed_by LEFT JOIN media ON r.target_type = 'MEDIA' AND media.id = r.target_id WHERE r.id = #{reportId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{afterStatus}, decision_reason = #{decisionReason}, processed_by = #{processedBy}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = #{processedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status IN (0, 1) AND version = #{expectedVersion}
